Earth Science Education asks for 15 credits chosen from "EPS 365 or (ASTR 1115 and 1115L); GEOL 2140; any EPS or ENVS course 300-level or above", with 12 at the 300 level or above. Are EPS 365 and GEOL 2140 required, or examples?
Three concentrations require 6 credits of "coursework approved by program". Is there a list a student can plan from?
